+    ]
+    for name, value in arguments.items():
+        if isinstance(value, bool):
+            rendered = "true" if value else "false"
+        elif value is None:
+            rendered = "null"
+        elif isinstance(value, (dict, list, tuple)):
+            rendered = _escape(_json(value))
+        else:
+            rendered = _escape(value)
+        rendered = html.escape(rendered, quote=False)
+        parts.extend(
+            [
+                '<atem:parameter name="',
+                _escape_attribute(name),
+                '">',
+                rendered,
+                "</atem:parameter>\n",
+            ]
+        )
+    parts.append("</atem:invoke>\n</atem:function_calls>")
+    return "".join(parts)
+
+
+class MuseSparkRenderer:
+    is_prefix_stable: bool = False
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        tokenizer: Any,
+        config: MuseSparkRendererConfig | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._tokenizer = tokenizer
+        config = config or MuseSparkRendererConfig()
+        self._cutoff_date = config.cutoff_date
+        self._current_date = config.current_date
+        self._reasoning_effort = config.reasoning_effort
+        self._bos = tokenizer.bos_token or ""
+        self._verify_special_ids()
+
+    def _verify_special_ids(self) -> None:
+        for token, expected in (
+            (START_STR, START_ID),
+            (MESSAGE_STR, MESSAGE_ID),
+            (EOM_STR, EOM_ID),
+            (EOT_STR, EOT_ID),
+        ):
+            actual = self._tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(token)
+            if actual != expected:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"Tokenizer maps {token} to id {actual}, but Muse Spark expects "
+                    f"{expected}."
+                )
+
+    def _system_body(
+        self,
+        instructions: str | None,
+        tools: list[dict[str, Any]] | None,
+    ) -> str:
+        parts = [
+            "You are a helpful AI assistant.",
+            f"Knowledge cutoff: {self._cutoff_date}.",
+        ]
+        current_date = self._current_date
+        if current_date is None:
+            current_date = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
+        if current_date:
+            parts.append(f"Current date: {current_date}.")
+        if instructions:
+            for source, replacement in _EFFORT_TO_STRENGTH:
+                instructions = instructions.replace(source, replacement)
+            parts.append(instructions)
+        if tools:
+            parts.append(_render_tool_definitions(tools))
+        if not instructions or "reasoning strength:" not in instructions.lower():
+            strength = _REASONING_EFFORT[self._reasoning_effort]
+            parts.append(f"Reasoning strength: {strength}.")
+        parts.append(_render_valid_recipients(tools))
+        return "\n\n".join(parts)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _tool_name(message: dict[str, Any], messages: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
+        if message.get("name"):
+            return message["name"]
+        call_id = message.get("tool_call_id")
+        for candidate in messages:
+            for tool_call in candidate.get("tool_calls") or ():
+                if call_id is not None and tool_call.get("id") == call_id:
+                    return tool_call["function"]["name"]
+        raise ValueError("tool message has no name and no matching tool_call_id")
+
+    def _build(
+        self,
+        messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+        *,
+        tools: list[dict[str, Any]] | None,
+        add_generation_prompt: bool,
+    ) -> list[_Piece]:
+        messages = _normalize_tool_calls(messages)
+        pieces: list[_Piece] = []
+        generation_active = False
+
+        def emit(
+            text: str,
+            token_id: int | None,
+            sampled: bool,
+            message_index: int,
+            is_content: bool = False,
+            prompt_prefix_chars: int = 0,
+        ) -> None:
+            if text:
+                pieces.append(
+                    _Piece(
+                        text,
+                        token_id,
+                        sampled,
+                        message_index,
+                        is_content,
+                        prompt_prefix_chars,
+                    )
+                )
+
+        def block(
+            header: str,
+            body: str,
+            end: str,
+            *,
+            message_index: int,
+            sampled: bool,
+            assistant_output: bool = False,
+        ) -> None:
+            nonlocal generation_active
+            if assistant_output:
+                starts_generation = not generation_active
+                emit(
+                    START_STR,
+                    START_ID,
+                    sampled and not starts_generation,
+                    message_index,
+                    is_content=sampled and not starts_generation,
+                )
+                emit(
+                    header,
+                    None,
+                    sampled,
+                    message_index,
+                    is_content=sampled,
+                    prompt_prefix_chars=(len("assistant") if starts_generation else 0),
+                )
+                emit(
+                    MESSAGE_STR,
+                    MESSAGE_ID,
+                    sampled,
+                    message_index,
+                    is_content=sampled,
+                )
+            else:
+                generation_active = False
+                emit(START_STR, START_ID, False, message_index)
+                emit(header, None, False, message_index)
+                emit(MESSAGE_STR, MESSAGE_ID, False, message_index)
+            emit(body, None, sampled, message_index, is_content=True)
+            emit(
+                end,
+                EOT_ID if end == EOT_STR else EOM_ID,
+                sampled,
+                message_index,
+                is_content=sampled,
+            )
+            if assistant_output:
+                generation_active = end == EOM_STR
+
+        emit(self._bos, self._tokenizer.bos_token_id, False, 0)
+        rest = messages
+        instructions = None
+        if messages and messages[0].get("role") in {"system", "developer"}:
+            instructions = _render_content(messages[0].get("content"))
+            rest = messages[1:]
+        block(
+            "system",
+            self._system_body(instructions, tools),
+            EOT_STR,
+            message_index=0,
+            sampled=False,
+        )
+        self._build_messages(rest, messages, pieces, block)
+        if add_generation_prompt:
+            index = max(len(messages) - 1, 0)
+            emit(START_STR, START_ID, False, index)
+            emit("assistant", None, False, index)
+        return pieces
+
+    def _build_messages(
+        self,
+        rest: list[dict[str, Any]],
+        all_messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+        pieces: list[_Piece],
+        block: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        del pieces
+        offset = len(all_messages) - len(rest)
+        for position, message in enumerate(rest):
+            index = offset + position
+            role = message.get("role")
+            same_role_next = (
+                position + 1 < len(rest) and rest[position + 1].get("role") == role
+            )
+            end = EOM_STR if same_role_next else EOT_STR
+            if role in {"system", "developer", "user"}:
+                self._build_plain_message(role, message, index, block)
+            elif role == "tool":
+                self._build_tool_message(message, all_messages, index, block)
+            elif role == "assistant":
+                self._build_assistant_message(message, end, index, block)
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(f"Unsupported Muse Spark chat role: {role!r}")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _build_plain_message(
+        role: str,
+        message: dict[str, Any],
+        index: int,
+        block: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        body = _render_content(message.get("content"))
+        if (
+            role == "user"
+            and message.get("render_timestamp")
+            and message.get("timestamp")
+        ):
+            timestamp = message["timestamp"]
+            if isinstance(timestamp, str):
+                body = f"[{_escape_header(timestamp)}] {body}"
+            elif hasattr(timestamp, "strftime"):
+                body = f"[{timestamp.strftime('%a %Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z').strip()}] {body}"
+        block(role, body, EOT_STR, message_index=index, sampled=False)
+
+    def _build_tool_message(
+        self,
+        message: dict[str, Any],
+        all_messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+        index: int,
+        block: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        name = self._tool_name(message, all_messages)
+        body = (
+            f'<tool_output name="{_escape_attribute(name)}">\n'
+            f"{_render_content(message.get('content'))}\n</tool_output>"
+        )
+        block(
+            f"tool {_escape_header(name)}",
+            body,
+            EOT_STR,
+            message_index=index,
+            sampled=False,
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _build_assistant_message(
+        message: dict[str, Any],
+        end: str,
+        index: int,
+        block: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        loss = message.get("loss", True)
+        if type(loss) is not bool:
+            raise ValueError("assistant message loss must be a bool when provided")
+        reasoning = message.get("reasoning_content") or message.get("reasoning")
+        if reasoning:
+            block(
+                "assistant to=self",
+                _escape(reasoning),
+                EOM_STR,
+                message_index=index,
+                sampled=loss,
+                assistant_output=True,
+            )
+        body = _render_content(message.get("content"))
+        tool_calls = message.get("tool_calls")
+        if tool_calls:
+            if body:
+                block(
+                    "assistant to=commentary",
+                    body,
+                    EOM_STR,
+                    message_index=index,
+                    sampled=loss,
+                    assistant_output=True,
+                )
+            for call_index, tool_call in enumerate(tool_calls):
+                call_end = end if call_index == len(tool_calls) - 1 else EOM_STR
+                name = tool_call["function"]["name"]
+                block(
+                    f"assistant to={_escape_header(name)}",
+                    _render_atem(tool_call),
+                    call_end,
+                    message_index=index,
+                    sampled=loss,
+                    assistant_output=True,
+                )
+            return
+        if body or not reasoning:
+            recipient = message.get("recipient") or "user"
+            if recipient == "user":
+                end_turn = True
+            elif recipient in {"self", "commentary"}:
+                end_turn = False
+            elif message.get("end_turn") is not None:
+                end_turn = message["end_turn"]
+            else:
+                end_turn = False
+            block(
+                f"assistant to={_escape_header(recipient)}",
+                body,
+                EOT_STR if end_turn else EOM_STR,
+                message_index=index,
+                sampled=loss,
+                assistant_output=True,
+            )
+
+    def _encode(self, piece: _Piece) -> tuple[list[int], list[bool]]:
+        if piece.token_id is not None:
+            return [piece.token_id], [piece.sampled]
+        if not piece.prompt_prefix_chars:
+            token_ids = self._tokenizer.encode(piece.text, add_special_tokens=False)
+            return token_ids, [piece.sampled] * len(token_ids)
+
+        attributed = attribute_text_segments(
+            self._tokenizer,
+            [
+                (piece.text[: piece.prompt_prefix_chars], False),
+                (piece.text[piece.prompt_prefix_chars :], piece.sampled),
+            ],
+        )
+        return (
+            [token_id for token_id, _ in attributed],
+            [sampled for _, sampled in attributed],
+        )
+
+    def _render_text(
+        self,
+        messages: list[dict[str, Any]],
+        *,
+        tools: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
+        add_generation_prompt: bool = False,
+    ) -> str:
+        return "".join(
+            piece.text
+            for piece in self._build(
+                messages,
+                tools=tools,
+                add_generation_prompt=add_generation_prompt,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def get_stop_token_ids(self) -> list[int]:
+        return [EOT_ID, EOS_ID]
+
+    def render_ids(
+        self,
+        messages: list[Message],
+        *,
+        tools: list[ToolSpec] | None = None,
+        add_generation_prompt: bool = False,
+    ) -> list[int]:
+        return [
+            token_id
+            for piece in self._build(
+                cast(list[dict[str, Any]], messages),
+                tools=cast(list[dict[str, Any]] | None, tools),
+                add_generation_prompt=add_generation_prompt,
+            )
+            for token_id in self._encode(piece)[0]
+        ]
+
+    def render(
+        self,
+        messages: list[Message],
+        *,
+        tools: list[ToolSpec] | None = None,
+        add_generation_prompt: bool = False,
+    ) -> RenderedTokens:
+        pieces = self._build(
+            cast(list[dict[str, Any]], messages),
+            tools=cast(list[dict[str, Any]] | None, tools),
+            add_generation_prompt=add_generation_prompt,
+        )
+        token_ids: list[int] = []
+        message_indices: list[int] = []
+        sampled_mask: list[bool] = []
+        is_content: list[bool] = []
+        for piece in pieces:
+            encoded, piece_sampled_mask = self._encode(piece)
+            token_ids.extend(encoded)
+            message_indices.extend([piece.message_index] * len(encoded))
+            sampled_mask.extend(piece_sampled_mask)
+            if piece.prompt_prefix_chars and piece.is_content:
+                is_content.extend(piece_sampled_mask)
+            else:
+                is_content.extend([piece.is_content] * len(encoded))
+        return RenderedTokens(
+            token_ids=token_ids,
+            message_indices=message_indices,
+            sampled_mask=sampled_mask,
+            is_content=is_content,
+            message_roles=[cast(str, message.get("role")) for message in messages],
+            message_tool_names=[message.get("name") for message in messages],
+            multi_modal_data=None,
+        )
+
+    def bridge_to_next_turn(
+        self,
+        previous_prompt_ids: list[int],
+        previous_completion_ids: list[int],
+        new_messages: list[Message],
+        *,
+        tools: list[ToolSpec] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Have TokenEnv re-render the full history for the next turn."""
+        return None
+
+    def parse_response(
+        self,
+        token_ids: list[int],
+        *,
+        tools: list[ToolSpec] | None = None,
+    ) -> ParsedResponse:
+        text = self._tokenizer.decode(token_ids, skip_special_tokens=False)
+        param_index = _build_param_type_index(tools)
+        reasoning: list[str] = []
+        content: list[str] = []
+        tool_calls: list[ParsedToolCall] = []
+        for channel in _CHANNEL.finditer(text):
+            recipient = channel.group("recipient") or "user"
+            body = channel.group("body").strip()
+            calls = _parse_atem(body, param_index=param_index)
+            if calls:
+                tool_calls.extend(calls)
+            elif recipient == "self":
+                reasoning.append(body)
+            else:
+                content.append(body)
+        return ParsedResponse(
+            content="\n".join(filter(None, content)).strip(),
+            reasoning_content="\n".join(filter(None, reasoning)).strip() or None,
+            tool_calls=tool_calls,
+        )
+
+
+def _parse_atem(
+    text: str,
+    *,
+    param_index: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, Any]]],
+) -> list[ParsedToolCall]:
+    parsed: list[ParsedToolCall] = []
+    for match in _ATEM_CALL.finditer(text):
+        name = html.unescape(match.group("name"))
+        params = param_index.get(name, {})
+        arguments: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        any_json_fallback = False
+        for parameter in _ATEM_PARAMETER.finditer(match.group("body")):
+            parameter_name = html.unescape(parameter.group("name"))
+            value, used_fallback = _coerce_arg_value(
+                html.unescape(parameter.group("value")),
+                params.get(parameter_name),
+            )
+            arguments[parameter_name] = value
+            any_json_fallback = any_json_fallback or used_fallback
+        parsed.append(
+            ParsedToolCall(
+                raw=match.group(0),
+                name=name,
+                arguments=arguments,
+                status=(
+                    ToolCallParseStatus.INVALID_JSON
+                    if any_json_fallback
+                    else ToolCallParseStatus.OK
+                ),
+            )
+        )
+    return parsed

+def _transformers_checkpoint_key(key: str) -> str:
+    if key in _TEXT_TOP_LEVEL_RENAMES:
+        return _TEXT_TOP_LEVEL_RENAMES[key]
+    if key in _VISION_TOP_LEVEL_RENAMES:
+        return _VISION_TOP_LEVEL_RENAMES[key]
+
+    match = re.match(r"model\.layers\.(\d+)\.(.+)", key)
+    if match is not None:
+        layer_id, suffix = match.groups()
+        return f"model.language_model.layers.{layer_id}.{_TEXT_LAYER_RENAMES[suffix]}"
+
+    match = re.match(r"vision_model\.encoder\.layers\.(\d+)\.(.+)", key)
+    if match is not None:
+        layer_id, suffix = match.groups()
+        return f"model.vision_tower.layers.{layer_id}.{_VISION_LAYER_RENAMES[suffix]}"
+
+    audio_prefix = "modalities.soft_audio_perception.interaction_encoder."
+    if key.startswith(audio_prefix):
+        suffix = key.removeprefix(audio_prefix)
+        if suffix in _AUDIO_TOP_LEVEL_RENAMES:
+            return f"model.audio_tower.{_AUDIO_TOP_LEVEL_RENAMES[suffix]}"
+        match = re.match(r"stages\.(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(.+)", suffix)
+        if match is not None:
+            stage_id, block_id_text, module = match.groups()
+            block_id = int(block_id_text)
+            if block_id == 0:
+                return f"model.audio_tower.layers.{stage_id}.{_AUDIO_PATCH_RENAMES[module]}"
+            return (
+                f"model.audio_tower.layers.{stage_id}.conv_blocks."
+                f"{block_id - 1}.{_AUDIO_BLOCK_RENAMES[module]}"
+            )
+    raise ValueError(f"unsupported Muse Spark checkpoint key: {key}")

+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _MappingSpec:
+    checkpoint_key: str
+    native_keys: tuple[str, ...]
+    transform: Literal["identity", "transpose", "packed_w13", "rope"] = "identity"
+    num_heads: int | None = None
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _TensorMetadata:
+    shape: tuple[int, ...]
+    dtype: torch.dtype
+
+
+def _permute_rope_rows(tensor: torch.Tensor, num_heads: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    head_dim = tensor.shape[0] // num_heads
+    return (
+        tensor.reshape(num_heads, head_dim // 2, 2, *tensor.shape[1:])
+        .transpose(1, 2)
+        .reshape(tensor.shape)
+    )
+
+
+def _unpermute_rope_rows(tensor: torch.Tensor, num_heads: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    head_dim = tensor.shape[0] // num_heads
+    return (
+        tensor.reshape(num_heads, 2, head_dim // 2, *tensor.shape[1:])
+        .transpose(1, 2)
+        .reshape(tensor.shape)
+    )
+
+
+def _is_row_sharded(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    return isinstance(tensor, DTensor) and any(
+        placement.is_shard(0) for placement in tensor.placements
+    )
+
+
+def _is_feature_sharded(w13: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``w13.flatten(1, 2)`` would give each rank non-contiguous rows.
+
+    ``w13`` is ``(E, 2, F, D)`` (dim 1: gate, up), and ``gate_up_proj`` is
+    ``(E, 2F, D)``. With ``Shard(2)`` on ranks A and B and F = 4, one expert's
+    rows are:
+
+        gate_up_proj row:  0   1   2   3   4   5   6   7
+                           g0  g1  g2  g3  u0  u1  u2  u3
+        owner:             A   A   B   B   A   A   B   B
+
+    torch_checkpointing loads a shard as one contiguous slice, so it would
+    silently fill A's view with g0-g3. Such a ``w13`` is copied instead.
+    Dim 1 is never sharded in TorchTitan but is checked the same way.
+    """
+    return isinstance(w13, DTensor) and any(
+        isinstance(placement, Shard) and placement.dim in (1, 2)
+        for placement in w13.placements
+    )
+
+
+def _permute_rope_tensors(
+    tensors: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+    num_heads: int,
+    permute: Callable[[torch.Tensor, int], torch.Tensor],
+) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+    """Apply a RoPE row permutation to row-sharded DTensors that share rows and sharding.
+
+    A row shard can hold part of a head, which a head-wise reshape cannot split,
+    so the tensors are gathered first. Viewing each as ``(rows, -1)`` and
+    concatenating along columns lets the whole group share one gather; the result
+    is sharded like the inputs again.
+    """
+    first = cast(DTensor, tensors[0])
+    mesh, placements = first.device_mesh, first.placements
+    columns = [tensor.reshape(tensor.shape[0], -1) for tensor in tensors]
+    fused = cast(DTensor, torch.cat(columns, dim=1)).redistribute(
+        mesh, [Replicate()] * mesh.ndim
+    )
+    fused = cast(DTensor, permute(fused, num_heads)).redistribute(mesh, placements)
+    widths = [column.shape[1] for column in columns]
+    return [
+        part.reshape(tensor.shape)
+        for part, tensor in zip(fused.split(widths, dim=1), tensors, strict=True)
+    ]
+
+
+def _rope_group_key(tensor: DTensor, num_heads: int) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+    return (
+        tensor.device_mesh,
+        tensor.placements,
+        tensor.shape[0],
+        tensor.dtype,
+        num_heads,
+    )
+
+
+class MuseSparkStateDictAdapter(MoEStateDictAdapter):
+    """Map TorchTitan Muse Spark Open state to the Transformers checkpoint schema.
+
+    ``to_hf`` returns real tensors that any checkpointer can load into, keeping
+    the order ``to_hf(target DTensors) -> load -> from_hf``:
+
+    - Packed expert ``gate_up_proj`` (gate then up rows along dimension 1) is
+      a view of the native fused ``(E, 2, F, D)`` ``w13`` weight, unless
+      ``w13`` is sharded on its gate/up or feature dimension.
+    - Q and K use split-half RoPE order in the checkpoint, so they are
+      permuted copies.
+
+    Pipeline ranks may provide any union of complete top-level model components.
+    This matches ``ModelWrapper`` state from one or more local pipeline chunks
+    while still rejecting partial layers and unknown keys.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        model_config: MuseSparkModel.Config,
+        hf_assets_path: str | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(model_config, hf_assets_path=None)
+        self.hf_assets_path = hf_assets_path
+        self._native_metadata = self._build_native_metadata(model_config)
+        self._lora_native_keys = {
+            key
+            for key in self._native_metadata
+            if re.search(r"\.lora_[ab]\.weight$", key)
+        }
+        self._mapping_specs = self._build_mapping_specs()
+        self._validate_mapping_specs()
+        self._native_keys_by_pipeline_component = (
+            self._build_native_keys_by_pipeline_component()
+        )
+        self._checkpoint_keys_by_pipeline_component = (
+            self._build_checkpoint_keys_by_pipeline_component()
+        )
+        self._checkpoint_metadata = self._build_checkpoint_metadata()
+        self.fqn_to_index_mapping = None
+
+    def _routed_expert_fqns(self) -> Iterable[str]:
+        """Yield the native routed-expert path for every Muse MoE layer."""
+        for fqn, _, _, _ in self.model_config.traverse(MoE.Config):
+            yield f"{fqn}.routed_experts"
+
+    def _native_fused_linears_to_hf(
+        self,
+        state_dict: dict[str, Any],
+        *,
+        split_routed_experts: bool = False,
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Expose logical W1/W3 keys after an expert-backend transform."""
+        result = super()._native_fused_linears_to_hf(
+            state_dict,
+            split_routed_experts=split_routed_experts,
+        )
+        if split_routed_experts:
+            for experts_fqn in self._routed_expert_fqns():
+                self._split_stacked_linear(
+                    result,
+                    fused_key=f"{experts_fqn}.w13.weight",
+                    logical_keys=(
+                        f"{experts_fqn}.w1_EFD",
+                        f"{experts_fqn}.w3_EFD",
+                    ),
+                    dim=1,
+                )
+        return result
+
+    def _native_fused_linears_from_hf(
+        self,
+        state_dict: dict[str, Any],
+        *,
+        fuse_routed_experts: bool = False,
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Restore native W13 keys after an expert-backend transform."""
+        result = super()._native_fused_linears_from_hf(
+            state_dict,
+            fuse_routed_experts=fuse_routed_experts,
+        )
+        if fuse_routed_experts:
+            for experts_fqn in self._routed_expert_fqns():
+                self._stack_logical_linears(
+                    result,
+                    fused_key=f"{experts_fqn}.w13.weight",
+                    logical_keys=(
+                        f"{experts_fqn}.w1_EFD",
+                        f"{experts_fqn}.w3_EFD",
+                    ),
+                    dim=1,
+                )
+        return result
+
+    def _build_native_metadata(
+        self,
+        config: MuseSparkModel.Config,
+    ) -> dict[str, _TensorMetadata]:
+        with torch.device("meta"):
+            model = config.build()
+        state_dict = self._native_fused_linears_to_hf(
+            model.state_dict(),
+            split_routed_experts=True,
+        )
+        return {
+            key: _TensorMetadata(tuple(value.shape), value.dtype)
+            for key, value in state_dict.items()
+        }
+
+    def _build_mapping_specs(self) -> list[_MappingSpec]:
+        specs = self._build_unwrapped_mapping_specs()
+        from torchtitan.models.muse_spark.model import MuseSparkAttention
+
+        config = cast(Any, self.model_config)
+        result: list[_MappingSpec] = []
+        for spec in specs:
+            native_key = spec.native_keys[0]
+            transform = spec.transform
+            num_heads: int | None = None
+            if native_key.endswith("attention.qkv_linear.wq.weight"):
+                layer_id = int(native_key.split(".")[1])
+                attention = cast(
+                    MuseSparkAttention.Config, config.layers[layer_id].attention
+                )
+                transform = "rope"
+                num_heads = attention.n_heads
+            elif native_key.endswith("attention.qkv_linear.wk.weight"):
+                layer_id = int(native_key.split(".")[1])
+                attention = cast(
+                    MuseSparkAttention.Config, config.layers[layer_id].attention
+                )
+                transform = "rope"
+                num_heads = attention.n_kv_heads
+            elif re.search(r"vision_encoder\.layers\.\d+\.attn\.w[qk]\.", native_key):
+                assert config.vision_encoder is not None
+                transform = "rope"
+                num_heads = config.vision_encoder.num_heads
+            elif native_key.endswith("feed_forward.router.gate.weight"):
+                transform = "identity"
+            result.append(
+                _MappingSpec(
+                    _transformers_checkpoint_key(spec.checkpoint_key),
+                    spec.native_keys,
+                    transform,
+                    num_heads,
+                )
+            )
+        return result
+
+    def _build_unwrapped_mapping_specs(self) -> list[_MappingSpec]:
+        from torchtitan.models.muse_spark.model import (
+            MuseSparkAttention,
+            MuseSparkRMSNorm,
+        )
+
+        config = cast(Any, self.model_config)
+        specs = [
+            _MappingSpec(
+                "model.embed_tokens.weight",
+                ("tok_embeddings.embedding.weight",),
+            )
+        ]
+        for layer_id, layer in enumerate(config.layers):
+            checkpoint = f"model.layers.{layer_id}"
+            native = f"layers.{layer_id}"
+            attention = cast(MuseSparkAttention.Config, layer.attention)
+            post_attention_norm = cast(
+                MuseSparkRMSNorm.Config,
+                layer.post_attention_norm,
+            )
+            specs.extend(
+                [
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.self_attn.q_proj.weight",
+                        (f"{native}.attention.qkv_linear.wq.weight",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.self_attn.k_proj.weight",
+                        (f"{native}.attention.qkv_linear.wk.weight",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.self_attn.v_proj.weight",
+                        (f"{native}.attention.qkv_linear.wv.weight",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.self_attn.o_proj.weight",
+                        (f"{native}.attention.wo.weight",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.self_attn.pre_qkv_proj_norm.weight",
+                        (f"{native}.attention_norm.weight",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.add_attn.gate",
+                        (f"{native}.attention_residual.gate",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.pre_ffn_norm.weight",
+                        (f"{native}.ffn_norm.weight",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.post_ffn_norm.weight",
+                        (f"{native}.post_ffn_norm.weight",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.add_ffn.gate",
+                        (f"{native}.ffn_residual.gate",),
+                    ),
+                ]
+            )
+            if attention.output_gate is not None:
+                specs.append(
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.self_attn.o_gate_proj.weight",
+                        (f"{native}.attention.output_gate.weight",),
+                    )
+                )
+            if post_attention_norm.elementwise_affine:
+                specs.append(
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.post_attn_norm.weight",
+                        (f"{native}.post_attention_norm.weight",),
+                    )
+                )
+
+            if isinstance(layer.feed_forward, DenseFeedForward.Config):
+                specs.extend(
+                    [
+                        _MappingSpec(
+                            f"{checkpoint}.feed_forward.fc1_weight.w1.weight",
+                            (f"{native}.feed_forward.w1.weight",),
+                        ),
+                        _MappingSpec(
+                            f"{checkpoint}.feed_forward.fc1_weight.w3.weight",
+                            (f"{native}.feed_forward.w3.weight",),
+                        ),
+                        _MappingSpec(
+                            f"{checkpoint}.feed_forward.fc2_weight.w2.weight",
+                            (f"{native}.feed_forward.w2.weight",),
+                        ),
+                    ]
+                )
+                continue
+
+            moe = f"{native}.feed_forward"
+            experts = f"{moe}.routed_experts"
+            specs.extend(
+                [
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.feed_forward.router.weight",
+                        (f"{moe}.router.gate.weight",),

+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.feed_forward.expert_bias",
+                        (f"{moe}.expert_bias_E",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.feed_forward.pooler.weight",
+                        (f"{moe}.pooler.weight",),

+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.feed_forward.pre_expert_norm.weight",
+                        (f"{moe}.pre_expert_norm.weight",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.feed_forward.experts.w13_weight",
+                        (f"{experts}.w1_EFD", f"{experts}.w3_EFD"),
+                        "packed_w13",
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.feed_forward.experts.w2_weight",
+                        (f"{experts}.w2.weight",),
+                    ),
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.feed_forward.post_expert_norm.weight",
+                        (f"{experts}.output_postprocess.weight",),
+                    ),

+    @staticmethod
+    def _build_vision_mapping_specs(
+        config: MuseSparkModel.Config,
+    ) -> list[_MappingSpec]:
+        vision_encoder = config.vision_encoder
+        if vision_encoder is None:
+            return []
+
+        checkpoint = "vision_model"
+        native = "vision_encoder"
+        specs = [
+            _MappingSpec(
+                f"{checkpoint}.positional_embedding_vlm",
+                (f"{native}.positional_embedding_vlm",),
+            ),
+            _MappingSpec(
+                f"{checkpoint}.conv1_linear.weight",
+                (f"{native}.conv1_linear.weight",),
+            ),
+        ]
+        for norm in ("ln_pre", "ln_post"):
+            for parameter in ("weight", "bias"):
+                specs.append(
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint}.{norm}.{parameter}",
+                        (f"{native}.{norm}.{parameter}",),
+                    )
+                )
+
+        for layer_id in range(vision_encoder.num_layers):
+            checkpoint_layer = f"{checkpoint}.encoder.layers.{layer_id}"
+            native_layer = f"{native}.layers.{layer_id}"
+            for checkpoint_name, native_name in (
+                ("q_proj", "wq"),
+                ("k_proj", "wk"),
+                ("v_proj", "wv"),
+            ):
+                for parameter in ("weight", "bias"):
+                    specs.append(
+                        _MappingSpec(
+                            f"{checkpoint_layer}.attn.{checkpoint_name}.{parameter}",
+                            (f"{native_layer}.attn.{native_name}.{parameter}",),
+                        )
+                    )
+            for checkpoint_name, native_name in (
+                ("attn.out_proj", "attn.proj"),
+                ("ln_1", "norm1"),
+                ("ln_2", "norm2"),
+                ("mlp.c_fc", "mlp.linear_fc1"),
+                ("mlp.c_proj", "mlp.linear_fc2"),
+            ):
+                for parameter in ("weight", "bias"):
+                    specs.append(
+                        _MappingSpec(
+                            f"{checkpoint_layer}.{checkpoint_name}.{parameter}",
+                            (f"{native_layer}.{native_name}.{parameter}",),
+                        )
+                    )
+
+        for projection in ("c_fc", "c_proj"):
+            specs.append(
+                _MappingSpec(
+                    f"{checkpoint}.adapter.{projection}.weight",
+                    (f"vision_adapter.{projection}.weight",),
+                )
+            )
+        specs.append(
+            _MappingSpec(
+                "modalities.vision_perception.encoder.vision_projection.weight",
+                ("vision_projection.weight",),
+            )
+        )
+        return specs
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _build_audio_mapping_specs(
+        config: MuseSparkModel.Config,
+    ) -> list[_MappingSpec]:
+        audio_encoder = config.audio_encoder
+        if audio_encoder is None:
+            return []
+
+        checkpoint = "modalities.soft_audio_perception.interaction_encoder"
+        native = "audio_encoder"
+        specs = []
+        for stage_id in range(len(audio_encoder.layers)):
+            checkpoint_stage = f"{checkpoint}.stages.{stage_id}"
+            native_stage = f"{native}.layers.{stage_id}"
+            for parameter in ("weight", "bias"):
+                specs.append(
+                    _MappingSpec(
+                        f"{checkpoint_stage}.0.linear.{parameter}",
+                        (f"{native_stage}.patchifier.linear.{parameter}",),
+                    )
+                )
+            specs.append(
+                _MappingSpec(
+                    f"{checkpoint_stage}.0.norm.weight",
+                    (f"{native_stage}.patchifier.norm.weight",),
+                )
+            )
+            for block_id, block_name in ((1, "block1"), (2, "block2")):
+                for module_name, parameters in (
+                    ("conv.conv", ("weight", "bias")),
+                    ("norm", ("weight",)),
+                    ("linear1", ("weight", "bias")),
+                    ("linear2", ("weight", "bias")),
+                ):
+                    for parameter in parameters:
+                        specs.append(
+                            _MappingSpec(
+                                f"{checkpoint_stage}.{block_id}.{module_name}."
+                                f"{parameter}",

+                                ),
+                            )

+            ("o_proj", ("weight", "bias")),
+            ("dual_norm", ("weight",)),

+    def _validate_mapping_specs(self) -> None:
+        checkpoint_keys: set[str] = set()
+        native_keys: set[str] = set()
+        for spec in self._mapping_specs:
+            if spec.checkpoint_key in checkpoint_keys:
+                raise ValueError(f"duplicate checkpoint mapping: {spec.checkpoint_key}")
+            checkpoint_keys.add(spec.checkpoint_key)
+            for native_key in spec.native_keys:
+                if native_key in native_keys:
+                    raise ValueError(f"duplicate native mapping: {native_key}")
+                if native_key not in self._native_metadata:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"mapping references unknown native state: {native_key}"
+                    )
+                native_keys.add(native_key)
+
+        unmapped = set(self._native_metadata) - native_keys - self._lora_native_keys
+        if unmapped:
+            raise ValueError("unmapped native state: " + ", ".join(sorted(unmapped)))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _pipeline_component_for_native_key(key: str) -> str:
+        if key.startswith("layers."):
+            return ".".join(key.split(".", 2)[:2])
+        return key.split(".", 1)[0]
+
+    def _build_native_keys_by_pipeline_component(self) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
+        result: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
+        for spec in self._mapping_specs:
+            for key in spec.native_keys:
+                component = self._pipeline_component_for_native_key(key)
+                result.setdefault(component, set()).add(key)
+        return result
+
+    def _build_checkpoint_keys_by_pipeline_component(
+        self,
+    ) -> dict[str, set[str]]:
+        result: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
+        for spec in self._mapping_specs:
+            components = {
+                self._pipeline_component_for_native_key(key) for key in spec.native_keys
+            }
+            if len(components) != 1:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "checkpoint mapping crosses pipeline components: "
+                    f"{spec.checkpoint_key}"
+                )
+            component = next(iter(components))
+            result.setdefault(component, set()).add(spec.checkpoint_key)
+        return result
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_pipeline_local_key_set(
+        provided: set[str],
+        expected_by_component: dict[str, set[str]],
+        *,
+        missing_label: str,
+        unexpected_label: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        expected = set().union(*expected_by_component.values())
+        unexpected = provided - expected
+        if unexpected:
+            raise ValueError(f"{unexpected_label}: " + ", ".join(sorted(unexpected)))
+
+        included_components = {
+            component
+            for component, component_keys in expected_by_component.items()
+            if component_keys & provided
+        }
+        required = set().union(
+            *(expected_by_component[component] for component in included_components)
+        )
+        missing = required - provided
+
+        if missing or not provided:
+            missing = missing or expected
+            raise ValueError(f"{missing_label}: " + ", ".join(sorted(missing)))
+
+    def _build_checkpoint_metadata(self) -> dict[str, _TensorMetadata]:
+        metadata = {}
+        for spec in self._mapping_specs:
+            native = [self._native_metadata[key] for key in spec.native_keys]
+            if spec.transform in {"identity", "rope"}:
+                checkpoint = native[0]
+                if spec.transform == "rope" and (
+                    spec.num_heads is None
+                    or checkpoint.shape[0] % (2 * spec.num_heads) != 0
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        "RoPE mapping requires an even head dimension: "
+                        f"{spec.checkpoint_key}"
+                    )
+            elif spec.transform == "transpose":
+                if len(native[0].shape) != 2:
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"transpose mapping requires a matrix: {spec.checkpoint_key}"
+                    )
+                checkpoint = _TensorMetadata(
+                    (native[0].shape[1], native[0].shape[0]),
+                    native[0].dtype,
+                )
+            else:
+                w1, w3 = native
+                if (
+                    len(w1.shape) != 3
+                    or len(w3.shape) != 3
+                    or w1.shape[0] != w3.shape[0]
+                    or w1.shape[2] != w3.shape[2]
+                    or w1.dtype != w3.dtype
+                ):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        "packed_w13 mapping requires compatible rank-3 weights: "
+                        f"{spec.checkpoint_key}"
+                    )
+                checkpoint = _TensorMetadata(
+                    (w1.shape[0], w1.shape[1] + w3.shape[1], w1.shape[2]),
+                    w1.dtype,
+                )
+            metadata[spec.checkpoint_key] = checkpoint
+
+        return metadata
+
+    def _classify_checkpoint_keys(
+        self,
+        keys: set[str],
+    ) -> tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], set[str]]:
+        expected = set(self._checkpoint_metadata)
+        mapped = keys & expected
+        extra = keys - mapped
+        ignored_prefixes = (
+            "model.vision_tower.",
+            "model.vision_adapter.",
+            "model.vision_projection.",
+            "model.audio_tower.",
+        )
+        modalities = {key for key in extra if key.startswith(ignored_prefixes)}
+        unknown = extra - modalities
+        return mapped, modalities, set(), unknown
+
+    def _validate_checkpoint_key_set(
+        self,
+        keys: set[str],
+    ) -> tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str]]:
+        mapped, modalities, vision, unknown = self._classify_checkpoint_keys(keys)
+        missing = set(self._checkpoint_metadata) - mapped
+        if missing:
+            raise ValueError("missing checkpoint keys: " + ", ".join(sorted(missing)))
+        if unknown:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "unexpected checkpoint keys: " + ", ".join(sorted(unknown))
+            )
+        return mapped, modalities, vision
+
+    def _validate_checkpoint_index(self) -> None:
+        if self.hf_assets_path is None:
+            self.fqn_to_index_mapping = None
+            return
+        index_path = os.path.join(
+            self.hf_assets_path,
+            "model.safetensors.index.json",
+        )
+        try:
+            with open(index_path) as index_file:
+                index = json.load(index_file)
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            self.fqn_to_index_mapping = None
+            return

+        weight_map = index.get("weight_map")
+        if not isinstance(weight_map, Mapping):
+            raise ValueError("checkpoint index must contain a weight_map object")
+        weight_map = cast(Mapping[str, Any], weight_map)
+        mapped, _, _ = self._validate_checkpoint_key_set(set(weight_map))
+        fqn_to_index_mapping = {}
+        for key in mapped:
+            filename = weight_map[key]
+            if not isinstance(filename, str):
+                raise ValueError(f"checkpoint shard filename must be a string: {key}")
+            match = re.search(r"-(\d+)-of-\d+\.safetensors$", filename)
+            if match is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"invalid sharded safetensors filename for {key}: {filename}"

+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_tensor(
+        key: str,
+        tensor: torch.Tensor,
+        metadata: _TensorMetadata,
+    ) -> None:
+        if tuple(tensor.shape) != metadata.shape:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"shape mismatch for {key}: expected {metadata.shape}, "
+                f"got {tuple(tensor.shape)}"
+            )
+
+    def to_hf(
+        self, state_dict: dict[str, Any], *, to_quantized_layout: bool = False
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        del to_quantized_layout
+        self._validate_checkpoint_index()
+        fused_w13: dict[tuple[str, ...], Any] = {
+            (f"{fqn}.w1_EFD", f"{fqn}.w3_EFD"): state_dict[f"{fqn}.w13.weight"]
+            for fqn in self._routed_expert_fqns()
+            if f"{fqn}.w13.weight" in state_dict
+        }
+        state_dict = self._native_fused_linears_to_hf(
+            state_dict,
+            split_routed_experts=True,
+        )
+        provided_native = set(state_dict) - self._lora_native_keys
+        self._validate_pipeline_local_key_set(
+            provided_native,
+            self._native_keys_by_pipeline_component,
+            missing_label="missing native keys",
+            unexpected_label="unexpected native keys",
+        )
+
+        result: dict[str, Any] = {}
+        sharded_rope: dict[tuple[Any, ...], list[tuple[str, DTensor]]] = {}
+        for spec in self._mapping_specs:
+            if not set(spec.native_keys) <= provided_native:
+                continue
+            tensors = []
+            for native_key in spec.native_keys:
+                # pop, so each replicated Q/K copy is freed once it is permuted.
+                tensor = state_dict.pop(native_key)
+                if not isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                    raise ValueError(f"native state must be a tensor: {native_key}")
+                self._validate_tensor(
+                    native_key, tensor, self._native_metadata[native_key]
+                )
+                tensors.append(tensor)
+            if (
+                spec.transform == "packed_w13"
+                and len({tensor.dtype for tensor in tensors}) != 1
+            ):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "packed_w13 native weights must use the same dtype: "
+                    f"{spec.native_keys}"
+                )
+            w13 = fused_w13.get(spec.native_keys)
+            if spec.transform == "rope" and _is_row_sharded(tensors[0]):
+                assert spec.num_heads is not None
+                tensor = cast(DTensor, tensors[0])
+                key = _rope_group_key(tensor, spec.num_heads)
+                sharded_rope.setdefault(key, []).append((spec.checkpoint_key, tensor))
+                continue
+            if spec.transform == "identity":
+                checkpoint_tensor = tensors[0]
+            elif spec.transform == "transpose":
+                checkpoint_tensor = tensors[0].transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
+            elif spec.transform == "rope":
+                assert spec.num_heads is not None
+                checkpoint_tensor = _permute_rope_rows(tensors[0], spec.num_heads)
+            elif w13 is not None and not _is_feature_sharded(w13):
+                # Gate and up rows are adjacent in the fused (E, 2, F, D) weight,
+                # so flattening it gives the checkpoint's (E, 2F, D) layout
+                # without a copy.
+                checkpoint_tensor = w13.flatten(1, 2)
+            else:
+                checkpoint_tensor = torch.cat(tensors, dim=1)
+            result[spec.checkpoint_key] = checkpoint_tensor
+        for key, entries in sharded_rope.items():
+            permuted = _permute_rope_tensors(
+                [tensor for _, tensor in entries], key[-1], _permute_rope_rows
+            )
+            result.update(zip((name for name, _ in entries), permuted, strict=True))
+        return result
+
+    def from_hf(
+        self, hf_state_dict: dict[str, Any], *, is_quantized_layout: bool = False
+    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        del is_quantized_layout
+        keys = set(hf_state_dict)
+        mapped, modalities, vision, unknown = self._classify_checkpoint_keys(keys)
+        if modalities or vision:
+            self._validate_checkpoint_key_set(
+                keys,
+            )
+        else:
+            if unknown:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    "unexpected checkpoint keys: " + ", ".join(sorted(unknown))
+                )
+            self._validate_pipeline_local_key_set(
+                mapped,
+                self._checkpoint_keys_by_pipeline_component,
+                missing_label="missing checkpoint keys",
+                unexpected_label="unexpected checkpoint keys",
+            )
+
+        result = {}
+        sharded_rope: dict[tuple[Any, ...], list[tuple[str, DTensor]]] = {}
+        # Mapping order, not set order: every rank must gather the RoPE groups
+        # in the same order.
+        for spec in self._mapping_specs:
+            if spec.checkpoint_key not in mapped:
+                continue
+            tensor = hf_state_dict[spec.checkpoint_key]
+            if not isinstance(tensor, torch.Tensor):
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"checkpoint state must be a tensor: {spec.checkpoint_key}"
+                )
+            self._validate_tensor(
+                spec.checkpoint_key,
+                tensor,
+                self._checkpoint_metadata[spec.checkpoint_key],
+            )
+            if spec.transform == "identity":
+                result[spec.native_keys[0]] = tensor
+            elif spec.transform == "transpose":
+                result[spec.native_keys[0]] = tensor.transpose(0, 1)
+            elif spec.transform == "rope" and _is_row_sharded(tensor):
+                assert spec.num_heads is not None
+                tensor = cast(DTensor, tensor)
+                key = _rope_group_key(tensor, spec.num_heads)
+                entry = (spec.native_keys[0], tensor)
+                sharded_rope.setdefault(key, []).append(entry)
+            elif spec.transform == "rope":
+                assert spec.num_heads is not None
+                # to_hf returns RoPE weights as copies, so reorder in place
+                # rather than hold a second copy of every replicated Q and K.
+                with torch.no_grad():
+                    tensor.copy_(_unpermute_rope_rows(tensor, spec.num_heads))
+                result[spec.native_keys[0]] = tensor
+            else:
+                # Restore w13 directly; after a load into to_hf's view of w13,
+                # this is a view of the parameter itself.
+                w13_key = spec.native_keys[0].removesuffix("w1_EFD") + "w13.weight"
+                result[w13_key] = tensor.unflatten(1, (2, -1))
+        for key, entries in sharded_rope.items():
+            unpermuted = _permute_rope_tensors(
+                [tensor for _, tensor in entries], key[-1], _unpermute_rope_rows
+            )
+            result.update(zip((name for name, _ in entries), unpermuted, strict=True))
+        return self._native_fused_linears_from_hf(
+            result,
+            fuse_routed_experts=True,
+        )
+
+    def get_hf_storage_reader(
+        self,
+        path: str,
+        from_quantized: bool = False,
+        *,
+        thread_count: int | None = None,
+    ) -> HuggingFaceStorageReader:
+        if thread_count is None:
+            thread_count = _HF_LOAD_THREAD_COUNT
+        reader = super().get_hf_storage_reader(
+            path, from_quantized, thread_count=thread_count
+        )
+        metadata = reader.read_metadata().state_dict_metadata
+        mapped, _, _ = self._validate_checkpoint_key_set(set(metadata))
+        for key in mapped:
+            actual = metadata[key]
+            if not isinstance(actual, TensorStorageMetadata):
+                raise ValueError(f"checkpoint metadata must describe a tensor: {key}")
+            expected = self._checkpoint_metadata[key]
+            if tuple(actual.size) != expected.shape:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"shape mismatch for {key}: expected {expected.shape}, "
+                    f"got {tuple(actual.size)}"
+                )
+        return reader

+class _GenerationExtension(jinja2.ext.Extension):
+    tags = {"generation"}
+
+    def parse(self, parser: Any) -> jinja2.nodes.CallBlock:
+        lineno = next(parser.stream).lineno
+        body = parser.parse_statements(
+            ["name:endgeneration"],
+            drop_needle=True,
+        )
+        return jinja2.nodes.CallBlock(
+            cast(Any, self).call_method("_render_generation"),
+            [],
+            [],
+            body,
+        ).set_lineno(lineno)
+
+    def _render_generation(self, caller: Callable[[], str]) -> str:
+        return caller()
+
+
+def _raise_exception(message: str) -> None:
+    raise jinja2.exceptions.TemplateError(message)
+
+
+def _tojson(
+    value: Any,
+    ensure_ascii: bool = False,
+    indent: int | str | None = None,
+    separators: tuple[str, str] | None = None,
+    sort_keys: bool = False,
+) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(
+        value,
+        ensure_ascii=ensure_ascii,
+        indent=indent,
+        separators=separators,
+        sort_keys=sort_keys,
+    )
+
+
+def _strftime_now(fmt: str) -> str:
+    return datetime.now().strftime(fmt)
+

+class MuseSparkTokenizer(MultiModalTokenizer):

+    TOKEN_FIELDS: ClassVar[tuple[str, ...]] = (
+        *MultiModalTokenizer.TOKEN_FIELDS,
+        "audio",
+        "audio_start",
+        "audio_end",
+    )
+    # pyrefly: ignore[bad-override]
+    LOSS_MASK_TOKEN_FIELDS: ClassVar[tuple[str, ...]] = (
+        *MultiModalTokenizer.LOSS_MASK_TOKEN_FIELDS,
+        "audio",
+        "audio_start",
+        "audio_end",
+    )
+
+    def set_chat_template(self, template: str) -> None:
+        """Compile Muse templates while rendering generation blocks normally."""
+        env = jinja2.sandbox.ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment(
+            trim_blocks=True,
+            lstrip_blocks=True,
+            extensions=[_GenerationExtension, jinja2.ext.loopcontrols],
+        )
+        env.globals["raise_exception"] = _raise_exception
+        env.globals["strftime_now"] = _strftime_now

+Shape suffixes:
+- T = packed visual tokens
+- D = vision dim
+- H = height
+- W = width
+- N = generic patch count
+- P = flattened patch-vector dim
+- G = spatial grid tokens
+- M = merged visual tokens
+- O = adapter output dim
+

+def _identity_rope(
+    query_TNH: torch.Tensor,
+    key_TNH: torch.Tensor,
+    rope_cache: torch.Tensor,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    _ = rope_cache
+    return query_TNH, key_TNH
+
+
+def _annotate_vision_activation_type(tensor: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if spmd.is_type_checking():
+        return spmd.mutate_type(
+            tensor,
+            src=spmd.R,
+            dst={"dp": spmd.V, "cp": spmd.I, "tp": spmd.I},
+        )
+    return tensor

+def reorder_patch_vector_channel_temporal(
+    patches_NP: torch.Tensor, *, patch_size: int, patch_temporal: int
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Reorder patch vectors from ``(C, PT, PH, PW)`` to ``(PT, C, PH, PW)``.
+
+    The shared multimodal collator emits flattened patch vectors in
+    channel-first layout to match Conv3d kernels. Some pretrained ViT patch
+    projections instead expect temporal-first vectors, so those encoders call
+    this helper before their linearized patch projection.
+    """
+    num_patches, patch_dim = patches_NP.shape
+    channels = patch_dim // (patch_temporal * patch_size * patch_size)
+    return (
+        patches_NP.view(
+            num_patches,
+            channels,
+            patch_temporal,
+            patch_size,
+            patch_size,
+        )
+        .permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
+        .reshape(num_patches, patch_dim)
+    )

+class MuseSparkNaViTAdapter(Module):
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class Config(Module.Config):
+        c_fc: Linear.Config
+        c_proj: Linear.Config
+        act_fn: GELU.Config = field(default_factory=GELU.Config)
+
+    def __init__(self, config: Config) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.c_fc = config.c_fc.build()
+        self.c_proj = config.c_proj.build()
+        self.act_fn = config.act_fn.build()
+
+    def forward(self, value_MO: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.act_fn(self.c_proj(self.act_fn(self.c_fc(value_MO))))

+        def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+            if self.head_dim % 4:

+    def __init__(self, config: Config) -> None:

+        latent_dim: int
+        output_dim: int
+        num_layers: int
+        num_heads: int
+        head_dim: int
+        patch_size: int
+        patch_temporal: int
+        downsample_factor: int
+        sparse_attention_factor: int
+        pos_emb_grid_h: int
+        pos_emb_grid_w: int
+        rope_freq: VisionRopeFreq.Config
+        conv1: Linear.Config
+        ln_pre: LayerNorm.Config
+        block: VisionTransformerBlock.Config
+        ln_post: LayerNorm.Config
+        use_rope: bool = True
+        grid_sample_mode: str = "bilinear"
+        pos_emb_grid_order: str = "raster"
+
+    def __init__(self, config: Config) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if config.output_dim != config.latent_dim * config.downsample_factor**2:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "NaViTEncoder output_dim must equal latent_dim * "
+                "downsample_factor squared"
+            )
+        if config.latent_dim % config.num_heads:
+            raise ValueError("vision hidden size must be divisible by attention heads")
+        if config.head_dim != config.latent_dim // config.num_heads:
+            raise ValueError("vision head_dim must equal latent_dim // num_heads")
+        if config.patch_size <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("NaViT patch size must be positive")
+        if config.patch_temporal <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("NaViT temporal patch size must be positive")
+        if config.downsample_factor <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("NaViT downsample factor must be positive")
+        if config.sparse_attention_factor <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("NaViT sparse attention factor must be positive")
+        if config.pos_emb_grid_h <= 0 or config.pos_emb_grid_w <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("NaViT positional embedding grid must be positive")
+        if config.pos_emb_grid_order not in {"raster", "legacy_spark"}:
+            raise ValueError("NaViT positional embedding grid order is invalid")
+
+        self.patch_size = config.patch_size
+        self.patch_temporal = config.patch_temporal
+        self.downsample_factor = config.downsample_factor
+        self.sparse_attention_factor = config.sparse_attention_factor
+        self.pos_emb_grid_h = config.pos_emb_grid_h
+        self.pos_emb_grid_w = config.pos_emb_grid_w
+        self.use_rope = config.use_rope
+        self.grid_sample_mode = config.grid_sample_mode
+        self.pos_emb_grid_order = config.pos_emb_grid_order
+
+        self.rope_freq = config.rope_freq.build()
+        self.conv1_linear = config.conv1.build()
+        self.positional_embedding_vlm = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(
+                config.pos_emb_grid_h * config.pos_emb_grid_w,
+                config.latent_dim,
+            )
+        )
+        self.ln_pre = config.ln_pre.build()
+        self.layers = ModuleDict(
+            {str(index): config.block.build() for index in range(config.num_layers)}
+        )
+        self.ln_post = config.ln_post.build()
+
+    def _make_2d_rope(
+        self,
+        grid_h: int,
+        grid_w: int,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        inv_freq_D = self.rope_freq.inv_freq
+        pos_h_H = torch.arange(1, grid_h + 1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        pos_w_W = torch.arange(1, grid_w + 1, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+        pos_h_H = _annotate_vision_activation_type(pos_h_H)
+        pos_w_W = _annotate_vision_activation_type(pos_w_W)
+        idx_h_G = pos_h_H.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, grid_w).reshape(-1)
+        idx_w_G = pos_w_W.unsqueeze(0).expand(grid_h, -1).reshape(-1)
+
+        freq_h_GD = torch.outer(idx_h_G, inv_freq_D)
+        freq_w_GD = torch.outer(idx_w_G, inv_freq_D)
+        angles_GD = torch.cat([freq_w_GD, freq_h_GD], dim=-1)
+        return torch.view_as_complex(
+            torch.stack([torch.cos(angles_GD), torch.sin(angles_GD)], dim=-1)
+        )
+
+    def _get_pos_emb(
+        self,
+        grid_h: int,
+        grid_w: int,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        position_weights = self.positional_embedding_vlm
+        dtype = position_weights.dtype
+        pos_emb_DHW = (
+            position_weights.view(self.pos_emb_grid_h, self.pos_emb_grid_w, -1)
+            .permute(2, 0, 1)
+            .unsqueeze(0)
+        )
+        inv_h = 1.0 / grid_h
+        inv_w = 1.0 / grid_w
+        ys_H = torch.linspace(-1 + inv_h, 1 - inv_h, grid_h, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        xs_W = torch.linspace(-1 + inv_w, 1 - inv_w, grid_w, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        # grid_sample consumes coordinates as (x, y). The default path uses
+        # `ij` to keep H-major raster order and stacks `(xx, yy)`.
+        # `legacy_spark` preserves the Muse Spark Open/SGLang checkpoint convention,
+        # where `xy` indexing with `(y, x)` inputs is part of the learned
+        # positional layout.
+        if self.pos_emb_grid_order == "legacy_spark":
+            pos_xy = torch.stack(
+                torch.meshgrid(ys_H, xs_W, indexing="xy"),
+                dim=-1,
+            ).reshape(1, 1, grid_h * grid_w, 2)
+        else:
+            yy_HW, xx_HW = torch.meshgrid(ys_H, xs_W, indexing="ij")
+            pos_xy = torch.stack((xx_HW, yy_HW), dim=-1).reshape(
+                1, 1, grid_h * grid_w, 2
+            )
+        pos_xy = _annotate_vision_activation_type(pos_xy)
+        sampled = F.grid_sample(
+            pos_emb_DHW,
+            pos_xy,
+            mode=self.grid_sample_mode,
+            align_corners=False,
+        )
+        return sampled[0, :, 0].transpose(0, 1)
+
+    def _pixel_shuffle_downsample(
+        self,
+        value_GD: torch.Tensor,
+        grid_h: int,
+        grid_w: int,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        factor = self.downsample_factor
+        hidden_dim = value_GD.shape[-1]
+        return (
+            value_GD.view(
+                grid_h // factor,
+                factor,
+                grid_w // factor,
+                factor,
+                hidden_dim,
+            )
+            .permute(0, 2, 1, 3, 4)
+            .reshape(-1, factor * factor, hidden_dim)
+            .transpose(1, 2)
+            .reshape(-1, factor * factor * hidden_dim)
+        )
+
+    def _get_sparse_perm_and_slens(
+        self, grid_h: int, grid_w: int, device: torch.device
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        gh, gw = self.pos_emb_grid_h, self.pos_emb_grid_w
+        pad_h = math.ceil(grid_h / gh) * gh
+        pad_w = math.ceil(grid_w / gw) * gw
+
+        idx = torch.arange(grid_h * grid_w, device=device).view(grid_h, grid_w)
+        idx = _annotate_vision_activation_type(idx)
+        idx = F.pad(idx, (0, pad_w - grid_w, 0, pad_h - grid_h), value=-1).flatten()
+        idx = idx.view(pad_h // gh, gh, pad_w // gw, gw)
+        idx = idx.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).reshape(-1)
+
+        sp_perm = idx[idx != -1]
+        valid = (idx != -1).view(-1, gh * gw)
+        sp_slens = valid.sum(dim=1).to(torch.int32)
+        return sp_perm, sp_slens
+
+    def _embed_image(
+        self,
+        patches_NP: torch.Tensor,
+        grid_h: int,
+        grid_w: int,
+        device: torch.device,
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+    ) -> tuple[
+        torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, int, int, int, torch.Tensor | None, torch.Tensor
+    ]:
+        num_tokens = grid_h * grid_w
+        patches_NP = reorder_patch_vector_channel_temporal(
+            patches_NP,
+            patch_size=self.patch_size,
+            patch_temporal=self.patch_temporal,
+        )
+
+        x_TD = self.conv1_linear(patches_NP.to(device=device, dtype=dtype))
+        pos_emb_GD = self._get_pos_emb(grid_h, grid_w, device)
+        x_TD = self.ln_pre(x_TD + pos_emb_GD.to(dtype))
+
+        freqs_cis_GD = (
+            self._make_2d_rope(grid_h, grid_w, device)
+            if self.use_rope
+            else x_TD.new_empty((num_tokens, 0))
+        )
+
+        sp_perm: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        sp_slens = torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        if self.sparse_attention_factor > 1:
+            sp_perm, sp_slens = self._get_sparse_perm_and_slens(grid_h, grid_w, device)
+            x_TD = x_TD[sp_perm]
+            freqs_cis_GD = freqs_cis_GD[sp_perm]
+
+        return x_TD, freqs_cis_GD, num_tokens, grid_h, grid_w, sp_perm, sp_slens
+
+    def _finalize_image(
+        self,
+        x_TD: torch.Tensor,
+        grid_h: int,
+        grid_w: int,
+        sp_perm: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if sp_perm is not None:
+            inv_perm = torch.argsort(sp_perm)
+            x_TD = x_TD[inv_perm]
+        x_TD = self.ln_post(x_TD)
+        return self._pixel_shuffle_downsample(x_TD, grid_h, grid_w)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        pixel_values_NP: torch.Tensor,
+        *,
+        grid_thw: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        grids = grid_thw.tolist()
+
+        device = self.conv1_linear.weight.device
+        dtype = self.conv1_linear.weight.dtype
+        sf = self.sparse_attention_factor
+
+        all_x: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        all_freqs: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        all_sp_slens: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        all_global_slens: list[int] = []
+        per_frame_meta: list[tuple[int, int, int, torch.Tensor | None]] = []
+
+        offset = 0
+        for temporal, grid_h, grid_w in grids:
+            num_spatial_patches = grid_h * grid_w
+            for _ in range(temporal):
+                frame_patches_NP = pixel_values_NP[
+                    offset : offset + num_spatial_patches
+                ]
+                offset += num_spatial_patches
+                (
+                    x_TD,
+                    freqs_cis_TD,
+                    num_tokens,
+                    grid_h,
+                    grid_w,
+                    sp_perm,
+                    sp_slens,
+                ) = self._embed_image(frame_patches_NP, grid_h, grid_w, device, dtype)
+                all_x.append(x_TD)
+                all_freqs.append(freqs_cis_TD)
+                if sp_slens.numel() > 0:
+                    all_sp_slens.append(sp_slens)
+                all_global_slens.append(num_tokens)
+                per_frame_meta.append((grid_h, grid_w, num_tokens, sp_perm))
+
+        x_TD = torch.cat(all_x, dim=0)
+        freqs_cis_TD = torch.cat(all_freqs, dim=0)
+        rope_cache = freqs_cis_TD.unsqueeze(1)
+        rope_apply = (
+            cast(RopeApply, ComplexRoPE.apply_rotary_emb)
+            if self.use_rope
+            else _identity_rope
+        )
+        total_tokens = x_TD.shape[0]
+
+        sp_slens_cat = torch.cat(all_sp_slens) if all_sp_slens else None
+        global_slens = torch.tensor(
+            all_global_slens,
+            device=device,
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+        )
+        global_slens = _annotate_vision_activation_type(global_slens)
+        with spmd.no_typecheck():
+            full_attention_mask = create_block_diagonal_mask(
+                global_slens,
+                total_tokens,
+                device,
+            )
+            sparse_attention_mask = (
+                create_block_diagonal_mask(
+                    sp_slens_cat,
+                    total_tokens,
+                    device,
+                )
+                if sp_slens_cat is not None
+                else None
+            )
+
+        num_layers = len(self.layers)
+        for layer_id, layer in enumerate(self.layers.values()):
+            use_full_attention = layer_id == num_layers - 1 or (layer_id + 1) % sf == 0
+            if use_full_attention:
+                attention_mask = full_attention_mask
+            else:
+                assert sparse_attention_mask is not None
+                attention_mask = sparse_attention_mask
+            x_TD = layer(
+                x_TD,
+                rope_cache=rope_cache,
+                rope_apply=rope_apply,
+                attention_mask=attention_mask,
+            )
+
+        outputs: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        offset = 0
+        for grid_h, grid_w, num_tokens, sp_perm in per_frame_meta:
+            frame_TD = x_TD[offset : offset + num_tokens]
+            offset += num_tokens
+            outputs.append(self._finalize_image(frame_TD, grid_h, grid_w, sp_perm))
+        return torch.cat(outputs)
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "MuseSparkNaViTAdapter",
+    "NaViTEncoder",
+    "VisionRopeFreq",
+    "reorder_patch_vector_channel_temporal",
+]

+"""Sharding config for the Muse Spark Open NaViT encoder."""
+
+from dataclasses import replace
+
+import spmd_types as spmd
+from spmd_types import SpmdType
+from torch.utils._pytree import tree_map
+
+from torchtitan.distributed.parallelism_context import MeshAxisName
+from torchtitan.models.base.sharding import ShardingConfig
+
+
+DP = MeshAxisName.DP
+CP = MeshAxisName.CP
+TP = MeshAxisName.TP
+
+
+def cp_replicated_vision_sharding_config(config: ShardingConfig) -> ShardingConfig:
+    """Keep post-encoder perception projections CP-replicated."""
+
+    def replicate_cp(layout):
+        if isinstance(layout, SpmdType):
+            return SpmdType(
+                {**layout.local_type, CP: spmd.R},
+                partition_spec=layout.partition_spec,
+            )
+        return layout
+
+    def replicate_tree(value):
+        return tree_map(replicate_cp, value, is_leaf=lambda x: isinstance(x, SpmdType))
+
+    return replace(
+        config,
+        state_shardings=replicate_tree(config.state_shardings),
+        in_src_shardings=replicate_tree(config.in_src_shardings),
+        in_dst_shardings=replicate_tree(config.in_dst_shardings),
+        out_src_shardings=replicate_tree(config.out_src_shardings),
+        out_dst_shardings=replicate_tree(config.out_dst_shardings),
+    )
+
+
+def navit_encoder_sharding_config() -> ShardingConfig:
+    parameter_invariant = SpmdType({DP: spmd.R, CP: spmd.I, TP: spmd.I})
+    activation_invariant = SpmdType({DP: spmd.V, CP: spmd.I, TP: spmd.I})
+    return ShardingConfig(
+        state_shardings={"positional_embedding_vlm": parameter_invariant},
+        out_src_shardings=activation_invariant,
+        out_dst_shardings=SpmdType({DP: spmd.V, CP: spmd.R, TP: spmd.I}),
+    )
+
+
+def vision_rope_freq_sharding_config() -> ShardingConfig:
+    return ShardingConfig(
+        state_shardings={"inv_freq": SpmdType({DP: spmd.R, CP: spmd.I, TP: spmd.I})},
+    )

+            RoutedExperts.Config
+        ):
+            routed_experts.activation_fn = replace(expert_activation)
+    config = apply_transforms(
+        config,
+        [
+            DistMoeTransform(
+                expert_precision=expert_precision,
+                inplace_wgrad_accum=True,
+            )
+        ],
+    )
+    # The standard Muse override fuses SwiGLU inside stock routed experts.
+    # Dist-MoE replaces every debug and 816B expert and owns that fusion, so
+    # retaining the override would leave no legitimate target. The independent
+    # attention RoPE override remains applicable.
+    config.override.imports = [_MUSE_SPARK_HELION_ROPE_OVERRIDE]
+    return config
+
+
+def _use_forced_balanced_routing(model_config: MuseSparkModel.Config) -> None:
+    """Replace token-choice routers with deterministic round-robin routing."""
+    for _fqn, router, parent, attr in list(
+        model_config.traverse(TokenChoiceTopKRouter.Config)
+    ):
+        replacement = convert_config_type(
+            router,
+            RoundRobinTokenChoiceTopKRouter,
+        )
+        assert parent is not None and isinstance(attr, str)
+        setattr(parent, attr, replacement)
+
+
+def _use_flex_flash_attention(model_config: MuseSparkModel.Config) -> None:
+    """Select FA4 and layer-appropriate block-mask geometry under CP."""
+    for layer in model_config.layers:
+        attention = layer.attention
+        inner_attention = attention.inner_attention
+        if not isinstance(
+            inner_attention,
+            (
+                FlexInnerAttention.Config,
+                SlidingWindowFlexInnerAttention.Config,
+                KVAllGatherCPFlexInnerAttention.Config,
+                KVAllGatherCPSlidingWindowFlexInnerAttention.Config,
+            ),
+        ):
+            raise TypeError("Muse Spark scale recipes require Flex Attention")
+        inner_attention = replace(
+            inner_attention,
+            block_size=((256, 256) if attention.window_size is None else (256, 128)),
+            kernel_options={**inner_attention.kernel_options, "BACKEND": "FLASH"},
+        )
+        attention.inner_attention = inner_attention
+
+
+def _resize_to_muse_glimmer_patch_grid(
+    height: int,
+    width: int,
+    *,
+    patch_size: int,
+    merge_size: int,
+    max_image_tokens: int = _MUSE_GLIMMER_MAX_IMAGE_TOKENS,
+    **_: object,
+) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
+    """Select the closest-aspect-ratio merged-patch grid under the token cap."""
+    merged_patch_size = patch_size * merge_size
+    ideal_grid_h = height / merged_patch_size
+    ideal_grid_w = width / merged_patch_size
+    aspect_ratio = ideal_grid_w / ideal_grid_h if ideal_grid_h > 0 else 1.0
+    if ideal_grid_h * ideal_grid_w > max_image_tokens:
+        ideal_grid_h = math.sqrt(max_image_tokens / aspect_ratio)
+        ideal_grid_w = ideal_grid_h * aspect_ratio
+
+    candidates = list(
+        set(
+            itertools.product(
+                [math.floor(ideal_grid_h), math.ceil(ideal_grid_h)],
+                [math.floor(ideal_grid_w), math.ceil(ideal_grid_w)],
+            )
+        )
+    )
+    candidates = [
+        (grid_h, grid_w)
+        for grid_h, grid_w in candidates
+        if grid_h >= 1 and grid_w >= 1 and grid_h * grid_w <= max_image_tokens
+    ]
+    if not candidates:
+        candidates = [(max(1, round(ideal_grid_h)), max(1, round(ideal_grid_w)))]
+
+    grid_h, grid_w = min(
+        candidates,
+        key=lambda grid: abs(grid[0] / grid[1] - height / width),
+    )
+    return (
+        grid_h * merged_patch_size,
+        grid_w * merged_patch_size,
+        0,
+        0,
+    )
+
+
+def _muse_spark_mm_dataloader(
+    model_config: MuseSparkModel.Config,
+    dataset: SingleDatasetConfig,
+) -> GrainDataLoader.Config:
+    from torchtitan.components.data.multimodal.mm_collator import MultiModalCollator
+    from torchtitan.components.data.multimodal.mm_datasets import VisionProcessor
+
+    vision_encoder = model_config.vision_encoder
+    if vision_encoder is None:
+        raise ValueError("Multimodal Muse Spark must own a vision encoder")
+
+    base_processor = dataset.processor
+    if not isinstance(base_processor, VisionProcessor.Config):
+        raise ValueError("Multimodal vision datasets must use VisionProcessor.Config")
+    processor = replace(
+        base_processor,
+        patch_size=vision_encoder.patch_size,
+        temporal_patch_size=vision_encoder.patch_temporal,
+        spatial_merge_size=vision_encoder.downsample_factor,
+        resize_fn=_resize_to_muse_glimmer_patch_grid,
+        image_mean=(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
+        image_std=(0.5, 0.5, 0.5),
+    )
+    audio_encoder = model_config.audio_encoder
+    return GrainDataLoader.Config(
+        dataset=replace(dataset, processor=processor),
+        collator=MultiModalCollator.Config(
+            max_images_per_microbatch=8,
+            patch_size=processor.patch_size,
+            temporal_patch_size=processor.temporal_patch_size,
+            spatial_merge_size=processor.spatial_merge_size,
+            patch_order="raster",
+            build_mrope_positions=False,
+            waveform_pad_multiple=(
+                None if audio_encoder is None else audio_encoder.patch_size
+            ),
+            audio_input_channels=(
+                None if audio_encoder is None else audio_encoder.input_channels
+            ),
+        ),
+    )
